field_evidence.dataset_title: MPS Violence Against Women and Girls dashboard data
field_evidence.confidentiality_statement: Data is aggregated to address disclosure risk and support safe, responsible public use.

records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the official Metropolitan Police Service Violence Against Women and Girls dashboard data. The offence-based Location worksheet is aggregated by BCU, borough and ward, and the victim-based Location worksheet is also aggregated by BCU, borough and ward. The release states that aggregation is used to protect confidentiality. This batch binds the verified Campden ward code E05009390 to that unused official ward-level dataset window without extracting sensitive individual data, geometry, parcel joins or parcel progress.
